snippet.title: Stella Sora Official Release PV |「Memory of Stella」If We Embrace the Stars Right Now
snippet.description:
The stars twinkle as the journey begins. Stella Sora will officially release on October 19th!

May our bonds light up this journey filled with love and hope.

✧Battle with Trekkers in Light-action Fantasy RPG! Pre-register for Stella Sora Official Release now:
Google Play: http://bit.ly/4oeG9vJ
App Store: http://bit.ly/3Ko5K6G
Official Website: https://stellasora.global/

——
「Memory of Stella」
Singer: 佐々木 李子
Composer＆Producer: 苏逸_Suyi
Lyrics: エンドケイプ
 
Artist Management : 池島 涼 / 後藤 涼奈
Sound Director : Shine.He
Recording Engineer : 鈴木 彰
Guitar: Bitman
Keyboard: 滑行浣熊
Bass&Mixing: 苏逸_Suyi
Coordination&Special Thanks: 咻咻 / Arcueid

——
Stay updated with Stella Sora, find us here:

Stella Sora Official Website: 
https://stellasora.global/
